carrier.doc: The line's board carrier: one per board, carried by hand from station to station and located at each the same

nest.doc: A station's nest: the plate every station (laser, paste, LumenPnP) carries, that the carrier drops onto by hand.

stencil_frame.doc: The paste station's stencil frame: a printed stiffener the mylar foil is taped under, so the foil lies flat on

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: no AXES declared, so nothing moves
rows.source: a static assembly is fully judged by the fit rule; declare AXES in assembly.py for a machine

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 200.0 × 190.0 mm across 3 bodies at z = -10.00 (nest, pin_left, pin_right)
rows.limit: at least 5 mm in both axes
rows.source: union of the contact patches at the lowest plane; a span near zero in either axis is a line or point contact and will tip. Does not test the centre of mass.

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 3 bodies on the plane, 6 above it, none below
rows.source: the lowest plane is taken as the ground, so nothing can be below it by construction; this row records the split

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: no bought part declares a mass_g with a mass_source, so nothing says what the assembly weighs (6 of 9 bodies have no mass)
rows.source: judged once a bought part declares a mass (bought.py has the contract); `stance` says the footprint has area, not that the weight is over it
